infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Olympic Park and Lidcombe
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 8 and Sunday 9 August
  • Buses replace trains between Olympic Park and Lidcombe.

  • Saturday from 9pm to 3am, buses also replace trains between Parramatta, Lidcombe and Strathfield.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
40T7  Olympic Park, Lidcombe and return

Saturday night only
7AT1  Parramatta, all stations to Strathfield and return
54T1  Parramatta, express to Strathfield and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.
